name: generated-world
description: A generated world from a fixed seed: the player starts on open Grassland in chunk (0, 0) with the 3 x 3 chunks around them generated and render tiles drawn around the camera; crossing into another chunk generates the chunks around it and the tiles follow. Generation rules themselves are unit tested.

steps.comment: Chunk (0, 0) spans x 0..256; x 280 is in chunk (1, 0), whose neighbors include chunk (2, 0).
